# unseal.link

> A minimal paywall platform. Sellers paste any link, set a price, and share a paywall URL. Buyers pay via Stripe and receive email-based access.

## What it does

- Sellers paste any URL (Notion, Figma, Google Drive, GitHub, Discord invite, etc.)
- Set a price ($9.99 minimum)
- Get a shareable paywall link at unseal.link/pay/[slug]
- Buyers pay via Stripe Checkout and receive an unlock email
- One-time access, no buyer account required
- Sellers keep 95.5% (4.5% platform fee)

## Key pages

- /                        → Homepage / product overview
- /how-it-works            → Step-by-step explanation
- /pricing                 → Transparent fee structure
- /auth                    → Seller signup / login (magic link, no password)
- /dashboard               → Seller dashboard (protected)
- /pay/[slug]              → Public paywall page for buyers
- /sell-notion-template    → Guide: sell Notion templates
- /sell-figma-template     → Guide: sell Figma files
- /sell-discord-access     → Guide: sell Discord community access
- /sell-github-repo        → Guide: sell GitHub repo access
- /sell-course             → Guide: sell online course content

## Technical

- Built with Next.js 15 App Router, Supabase, Stripe Connect, Resend
- No content is hosted — platform controls access, sellers own their content
- Purchases are immutable snapshots (delivery URL captured at purchase time)
- Stripe is the source of truth for payouts
